messages:
release-bot: Quick bulletin: rolling release freeze starts 2025-02-18 16:00 UTC (soft). Purpose: stabilize infra before customer demo week. Exceptions allowed for P0/P1 and security fixes — see exemption flow below.

liz: Short status: canaries for v3.7.2 started at 08:00 UTC in us-east-1 (10%). Early telemetry: KV hit-rate down ~2% on embeddings path, P95 latency +4% on a small slice. We're watching.

omar: Note on exemptions: to request, add label `freeze-exempt`, include a one-paragraph rollback plan, and ping @ops-oncall + @release-bot. Approvals needed: SRE lead + release manager. Use `/approve-freeze-exempt PR-#### --reason "..."`. Exemptions expire after 8h unless extended.

ops-oncall: New enforcement: deploy-bot will auto-throttle late merges that lack the required checklist. Throttle log example: `deploy-bot: merge blocked - missing canary plan`. If blocked, open a release ticket and tag `urgent` and ops will triage.

mina: Canary readout snapshot (first 6h):
- traffic split: 10%
- errors: no user-visible errors
- latency: P95 +4% (embeddings path)
- resource: GPU mem stable
Plan: extend embeddings canary to 24h in eu-west to verify KV hit-rate recovery. If P95 rises >6% we rollback.

liz: Small rollout guidance: avoid schema or tokenization changes during freeze. Docs-only ok. If you must change a config key, request exemption and include compatibility tests.

qa-robot: Auto-tests: prewarm checks are now mandatory for model artifacts >1GB. CI snippet attached in the internal docs. Failing prewarm will mark PR red and prevent merge.

omar: Ops reminder: if you land a hotfix during the freeze, append `--audit freeze-2025-02` to the approval command so we can collect logs automatically.

release-bot: Follow-ups: I'll post final canary readouts at 2025-02-19 09:00 UTC and the exemption log. Please keep messages concise in this thread and file separate follow-ups in the release ticket. :loudspeaker: :white_check_mark:

liz: ack, posting dashboard links now in #release-dashboard.
